title: Helix Mono by HelixDB
note: Free monospace typeface by HelixDB, based on JetBrains Mono NL 2.304. 6 weights (200-700) with italics, 12 styles, WOFF2 + TTF, SIL Open Font License 1.1. The site itself is a nice reference: styled like a product manual ('Model HM-1', numbered sections, dotted-leader spec table). Found via @praveenjuge's font list (Nov 27, 2026). Thumbnail is a screenshot of the site.
